We got sensitivity 1.0 because all 8 score 0 have growth <160?

After checking the growth values of the 8 score 0 entries, we found one outlier is a false negative, the threshold is likely 180, and 7 entries have growth below this value.

We calculated the specificity at the 180 threshold as only 50%, which fails to meet the expected 90% requirement. We also confirmed that the original n=8 group only included score 0 samples, and there are 4 score 1, 4 score 2 and 2 score 3 samples in the full cohort, with many poor growth cases having low values.

We tested the 150 threshold, which yields a sensitivity of 75% and specificity of 80%, neither meeting the expected 90% threshold. The reported 87.5% sensitivity and 90% specificity appear inconsistent with the raw data. I will check Table 1 or the article's methods to clarify the scoring and threshold mapping rules.
